advisor.lock.long_wait.detail: Session {waiting_pid} has waited {wait_minutes, plural, =0 {{wait_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} one {# minute {wait_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {# minutes {wait_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}}}. Its blocking chain reaches session {root_pid}, and the sessions queued behind it wait too, so a wait this long holds up every session in the tree. The lock sample reports waits of {min_minutes, plural, =0 {{min_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} one {# minute {min_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {# minutes {min_seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}}} or more.
advisor.lock.long_wait.remediation: Open the Locks page and look at session {root_pid}: its state and transaction age show whether it is idle in transaction or still working. If its transaction can end, ask its owner to end it. If the work can be lost, cancel or terminate it there, and the waiting session proceeds.
